ownerDecision.scope: A second playable id beside the Challenger 3 TD (challenger3_td, release 262): the same measured demonstrator without the camouflage suit, fitted with a new remote machine-gun station and field equipment. The TD keeps its heavy beech ghillie (the owner's same-day ruling relayed by Main: 'challenger 3 td should get a tonn of ghillie as well'). Envelope measured on the release-262 build at both qualities with the suit left out; the whips set its top and the skirt hooks its width.

challenger3_td_rws.silhouette: The Challenger 3 Technology Demonstrator's measured hull, two-cheek turret, deep mantlet and 120 mm L55A1 (challenger3_td, from the 2021 demonstrator) without its camouflage suit, carrying a first-party remote weapon station: a 12.7 mm M2 in a two-cheek cradle on a yawing turntable over the loader's side of the roof, with its own day/thermal sight head and ready box; side bins, a full-width bustle basket with packs, a rolled camouflage net, tarp, jerrycans, spare track links, tow cable, shackles, pioneer tools and rations. The station is owner-authored equipment: no Challenger 3 demonstrator was photographed with it.
